summary: Borr Drilling Limited reported through a Form 6-K the early tender results of its consent solicitation and tender offer to purchase for cash any and all of its outstanding 10.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2028 and 10.375% Senior Secured Notes due 2030. As of the early deadline, 95.92% of the 2028 Notes and 90.56% of the 2030 Notes were tendered. The issuer also priced a new notes offering of $1.1B 8.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2032 and $935M 9.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2034 to finance the purchase. Holders cannot withdraw tenders; remaining notes will be redeemed. This is a debt restructuring/refinancing, not a special situation equity event.
